units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 39:11">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIX, 11</cite> <he>למֵיבְחוּשׁ וכ׳</he> to examine … the accounts.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:3">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>אדלא אבידנא בָחִישְׁנָא</he> I am searching for what I have not lost (of the aged man’s unsteady walk and bent figure).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 5b:15">B. Mets. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דב׳ וכ׳</he> until I may search and find it.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:5">Ib. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>בחוש אבתריה וכ׳</he> (not <he>בחיש</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) search for him and find him.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:14">Targ. Esth. I, 14</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:1">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>קא בחיש באילני</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he shook the trees.
<cite ref="Gittin 45a:22">Gitt. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>בחשן וכ׳</he> stirred a (hot) pot with their hands.
